# Operate DayQ Radio Communications

Read [FULL_CONTRACT.md](references/FULL_CONTRACT.md) and [INTEGRATION.md](references/INTEGRATION.md). Extend `$propagate-dayq-proximity-audio`; never create another voice truth or send protected audio to unauthorized clients.

1. Model every radio as a physical persistent assembly with controls, antenna, power, condition, calibration, trust module, mounting, repair, heat and signature.
2. Separate microphone/local speaker acoustics, conventional radio propagation, LoRa-class data mesh, intranet and backhaul.
3. Server-authorize recipients from owned functioning equipment, net, propagation/relay, credentials, permissions, moderation and privacy.
4. Represent intelligibility, delay/dropout/noise, leakage, detection/direction-finding uncertainty, congestion, interception, capture, revocation, outage and repair with counterplay.
5. Validate proximity/handheld/vehicle/repeater/base routes, unauthorized filtering, terrain/power/damage, AI leakage, capture/rekey, cartridge power, reconnect/restart, latency/load, privacy/accessibility and persistence.
